Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О дружбе' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Часто' adds habit, a clean reflective conversation pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Дружбы' is the nominative plural subject of 'забываются'. 'Старые' agrees in the plural, a reflective statement about lasting bonds.
